label: Corridor paths are measured geometry
value: Existing segments of each NH number from the MORTH/GatiShakti national highway layer (dated June 2022), sampled every 2 km and joined by a minimum spanning tree across holes of up to 150 km; the corridor is the tree's longest path. Length is measured on the full path; the drawn path is simplified to about 200 m. Top 18: the longest NH numbers plus major trunk routes. Segments under construction or proposed are excluded; the file has holes, so bridged stretches are straight lines. Lengths run about 5 to 12% below published figures for NH 44, 48 and 27.

label: Charger counts as 'near' a corridor
value: Within 5 km of the highway path (a 0.5 km sampled path, so distances are good to about 0.25 km)

label: Highway charger spacing norm
value: 25 km. The guideline reads 'on both sides of highways'; a station within the buffer on either side is counted as serving the corridor, so the add-count is per corridor, not per carriageway side.

label: Stations to add on a corridor
value: Sum over gaps longer than the norm of ceil(gap/norm) - 1

label: Site service radius
value: 1.5 km (half of the 3 km urban grid cell)

label: Site demand points
value: District EVs spread over up to 300 random points drawn around the district centroid (sd = quarter of the district's linear size); points within the radius of a listed charger are treated as served

label: Site candidates
value: OSM substation locations (grid proximity as a proxy for spare capacity) and toll plazas, inside the district; greedy maximal coverage, up to 4 sites in each of the 60 districts with the worst gap score; plus, for the 3 longest gaps on each corridor, the highway point nearest the midpoint, moved to an OSM fuel station within 300 m of the road and 2 km of the midpoint when one exists
source: data/raw/grid/osm_substations.json; morth_toll_plazas.parquet; OSM fuel stations in data/data.csv

label: Charger type and connectors
value: Corridor sites dc60 (dc120 where the gap exceeds 3x the norm); urban sites dc30 if they cover 150 or more EVs, else ac; connectors ac 4, dc30 2, dc60 4, dc120 4
